Host & active connections

IP access rules

Rules managed by this dashboard, without replacing the host firewall.

SSH and the IP of your current admin session are protected. Closing TCP does not prevent reconnection. IP blocking requires nftables.

One fetch. Every compatible client.

Fetch an official KoG profile on the server and publish it for automatic synchronization.

Fetch & distribute

Queries run in the background and may take a few minutes. Local imports are never published as verified KoG progress.

One lookup at a time, up to eight jobs queued. Clients download the saved profile without starting another scrape.

Titles, with your signature.

Create, style, and assign titles by key. Published through the signed server catalog.

New title

Your titleCLIENT PREVIEW
Customize an original title

IDs 0–54 retain their achievement requirements. This overrides their appearance on compatible clients.

Assign titles to a key

Assignments are additive: a key can receive several titles. They appear in Custom. The player chooses whether to equip them; the choice also applies to their dummy.

Permanent in-game title editor

Grant creation and editing of up to 16 owned titles. This permission has no monthly expiration and is independent of the key role. It can be revoked here.

The first compatible client update adds this catalog. Future title names, gradients, colors, RGB effects, and assignments then update without rebuilding. Older clients continue displaying their original titles.
